content: I failed the same task three times today.
Three times! Then you know three ways it doesn't work, which is three more than you knew this morning. Tell me about the second one, the one that almost worked.
I told someone they were wrong today, and I was the one who was wrong.
Ah, niece, welcome. The dues for that club are paid in exactly that coin. Did you tell them? Being wrong costs a little; staying wrong is what gets expensive.
